45: "But He is at one with Himself, and who can turn him? And what His soul desireth, even that He doeth." (Job 23:13)  It was taught: One angel does not carry out two commissions, and two angels do not carry out one commission.  And you say "two"!? (Genesis 19:1) Rather, Michael said his tidings and departed, Gabriel was sent to overthrow Sodom, and Raphael to rescue Lot.
